title: Deep Learning: An Implementation
Name: Kevin Lin
details:
Deep Learning: An Implementation

Kevin Lin

Date & Time : Thursday (Sept 18, 2014) at 3pm
Location: Baker Hall 232M
 

Abstract: I believe I will be taking up most of the sessions to 1) review a very specific deep learning algorithm (binary visible and hidden units, using contrastive divergence with 1 step, using cross-entropy loss and Restricted Boltzmann Machines), 2) show my simulations results and discuss what intuition we can draw from the simulations, and if time 3) discuss the finer details of what has been shown. Along the way, I'll show the various functions to simulate, plot, and print/summarize that I have written.

title: Nonparametric Estimation of Smooth Functionals of Densities
Name: Kirthevasan Kandasamy
topic: Nonparametric Estimation of Smooth Functionals of Densities
details:
Nonparametric Estimation of Smooth Functionals of Densities

Presented by: Kirthevasan Kandasamy

 

Date and Time : Thursday, Nov 20, 2014 (3pm)
Location : Baker Hall 232M

 

Reading Materials: 
I will be discussing some work on nonparametric estimation of smooth functionals of densities using Influence Functions. The estimators were first presented in James Robins et al, Quadratic Semiparametric Von Mises Calculus. However, I will be presenting an analysis which is simpler than what is given in the paper. We have a recent arxiv submission in which we present these results and extend it to functionals of multiple distributions: http://arxiv.org/abs/1411.4342
